name: analysis_file_cache_settings_read
description: Read where MPCut writes new cutcaches and whether the configured shared folder is available. Poll file_job_status_read with the returned job_id.

operation_id.description: Fresh UUID for a distinct file job. Reuse it to retry identical arguments.

name: analysis_file_cache_settings_set
description: Select where MPCut writes new cutcaches. Poll file_job_status_read with the returned job_id.

operation_id.description: Fresh UUID for a distinct file job. Reuse it to retry identical arguments.

folder.description: Optional writable shared folder when selecting disk mode. Omit it to retain the configured folder.

name: analysis_file_cache_preview
description: Discover cutcaches within an explicit folder. Review cache details, reclaimable bytes and clear tokens before selecting copies. Poll file_job_status_read with the returned job_id.

operation_id.description: Fresh UUID for a distinct file job. Reuse it to retry identical arguments.

folder.description: Absolute path to the folder to search recursively.

project_path.description: Optional saved project whose media and history are protected.

location.description: Limit results to this cache location.

name: analysis_file_cache_clear
description: Remove only the confirmed cache copies using tokens from a preview with the same folder, project and location. A changed selection requires a fresh preview. Poll file_job_status_read with the returned job_id.

operation_id.description: Fresh UUID for a distinct file job. Reuse it to retry identical arguments.

folder.description: Absolute path to the folder to search recursively.

project_path.description: Optional saved project whose media and history are protected.

location.description: Limit results to this cache location.

confirm.description: Confirm removal of the selected cache copies.
